title: Usable, validated XMP MVP without hardware
promise: A musician can start, make, finish, save, move and export a song in the XMP Device workflow on a Mac browser and inside the booted Linux device build; a contributor can build, test and package an original instrument; the owner's Akai Force is never touched.

requirements.title: Start making music with no hardware or setup
requirements.need: The default Device view opens in a browser, mirrors the Live Mk1 panel (pad 1 bottom left) and can be navigated before audio starts.

scenarios.name: Navigate with the Live Mk1 controls without starting audio
Verify the visible default panel and bottom-left pad numbering

requirements.title: Make a beat from samples
requirements.need: Load a kit or the sample library, program steps on pads and hear and export the loop.

scenarios.name: Get a drum track going using the whole indexed sample library
Make a drum loop from my sample library and export audio
Compare a drum kit using an existing pattern and undo the replacement

requirements.title: Layer sounds and record takes
requirements.need: Add a synth or second machine track, create variations and record an undoable pitched or finger-drummed take.

scenarios.name: Layer a second machine and copy a variation without replacing its machine
Keep machine controls extensible and record an undoable pitched take
Layer a synth bass and create a chorus variation
Finger-drum a take and undo the whole take

requirements.title: Arrange and perform a song
requirements.need: Launch clips at the next bar, chain scenes into a song and render it offline.

scenarios.name: Launch clips independently at the next bar and stop an empty track slot
Turn scenes into a portable song and render it offline
Arrange verse and chorus clips into a complete song

requirements.title: Mix and export
requirements.need: Balance tracks and export finished or alternative mixes as audio.

scenarios.name: Balance a track and export a muted alternative

requirements.title: Never lose work
requirements.need: Autosave and resume, undo whole operations, and reject damaged input or stale loads without replacing the current song.

scenarios.name: Resume an autosaved idea and transfer it to a fresh browser
Undo a destructive edit and reject a damaged project without losing work
Reject stale loads and delayed audio starts after cancellation
Reject a broken CC0 download and retain edits made during loading

requirements.title: Portable songs
requirements.need: Save .xmpsong files with or without samples, relink missing audio and keep the active song when a transfer is corrupt.

scenarios.name: FP01 - Transfer a packaged song between Device view and Advanced Studio
FP02 - Relocate the audio for a song saved without samples
FP03 - Reuse an installation's local sample library
FP04 - Keep the active song when a transfer is corrupt

requirements.title: Runs as its own OS
requirements.need: The Device interface boots inside an offline Linux image, keeps a song across a cold reboot, exchanges songs with the browser and builds ARMv7 artifacts, all on the Mac.

scenarios.name: D01 - Boot and see the real Device interface inside Linux
D02 - Build a clip song and keep it across a cold VM reboot
D03 - Invalid commands cannot escape the virtual control boundary
D04 - Build and execute ARMv7 artifacts without an instrument
FP05 - Transfer a browser song into Linux and bring a VM edit back

requirements.title: Contributors can extend it
requirements.need: Install the SDK offline, scaffold, build, test and package an original instrument or effect, with honest parity reporting.

scenarios.name: Install the SDK offline outside the XMP repository and inspect compatibility
Complete a supported instrument or effect development loop
Refuse false parity despite similar audio
Preserve work when unsupported packages or device targets are requested

requirements.title: Only distributable content ships
requirements.need: Bundled sounds are original or verified CC0 with recorded provenance; no vendor firmware, graphics, samples or plugins are included.

scenarios.name: Play a verified CC0 test kit using the existing song
Reject an invalid kit without a partial replacement

requirements.title: The Force stays untouched
requirements.need: Inventory is passive host metadata only; no target selector, allow flag or cable can authorize a Force write.

scenarios.name: Inspect cached host metadata without contacting the Force
A USB cable does not authorize a Force modification
A generic allow flag cannot authorize the protected Force
Standalone mode rejects a physical target selector

requirements.title: A new user can learn it
requirements.need: The manual and first-loop quick start are readable on a phone, with enlarged text and without JavaScript.

scenarios.name: Read the quick start at <width> pixels wide
Read and navigate the manual when JavaScript is unavailable

excluded: Installing, booting or testing anything on the Live Mk1 or the Force
Real-time timing qualification on hardware and the eight-hour run (60-second Mac sampler runs and the ARM guest engine pass; the Live Mk1's own timing is unmeasured)
Physical audio latency, loopback, external MIDI, CV and VST hosting
Touch display and physical control qualification
Eight-hour soak, signed hardware updates and public OS image redistribution
Requirements from the unretrieved external specification
